source: NARA-prepared layout in 125.10DP.pdf, verified byte for byte against RG330.DEFCON.FY76 records 1 through 6

notes.county_code: State-internal sequential county code, not FIPS. Monroe County Wisconsin appears as 041 where its FIPS county part is 081, so a name-and-state crosswalk to FIPS is required.
notes.dollars: Reported in thousands of dollars. The 10000 reporting threshold of this era appears as 000000010. The final byte is a zoned-decimal zone byte carrying the last digit and the sign. In FY1966-75 negative zero is written as a BLANK, which is unique to these ten files: 1,495 to 1,921 rows a year, replaced by ^ in FY1976-77 and } in FY1978-83. Reading it as positive inverts the sign of a deobligation and reading it as padding divides the amount by ten; see the ZONED table in code/py/dcads_common.py and README 1.5.
notes.action_date: Two-digit year followed by a letter month, A for January through L for December.
notes.geography: City, state and county describe the principal place of performance, DD350 item 7, not the contractor address in item 6.
notes.lumpsum: This era has no DD1057 lump-sum rows and no id_key field: every record is a single contract action, so is_lumpsum is 0 throughout. The mixing of contract and lump-sum rows begins with the 392-byte era in FY1984.
notes.field_renames: Two fields are renamed relative to the original 272 layout, for cross-era consistency: dollars_thousands is now dollars, with the unit carried in dollars_unit and in a dollars_unit column on the output; and fiscal_year is now fiscal_year_internal, so it cannot collide with the fiscal_year column derived from the filename.
notes.field_documentation: Every field carries a plain-English label. Unlike the later eras it carries no dod_name, because the MPCF-era layout in 125.10DP.pdf prints a description column but not the short field mnemonics that the FY1984-onward layouts use. Rather than invent mnemonics, they are left absent; the label plus the byte offsets are enough to trace any column back to that document.

fields.name: fsc
fields.label: Federal supply class or service code

fields.name: action_date
fields.label: Action date, year and letter month A-L for January-December. When the action was OBLIGATED, which is not the reporting period: see report_month.
